legal.short: This plugin is a tool, not legal advice, and it does not guarantee compliance with the law. Check your settings and texts with a lawyer.
legal.full: This plugin is a tool. It is not legal advice and does not guarantee that your store complies with GPSR, GDPR, the Omnibus rules or any other law. Periods, scopes and exceptions are settings with default values; whether they fit your store is for you and your lawyer to decide. Every legal text (consents, notices, terms) has to come from your lawyer.

guide.title: Guide
guide.intro: What each module does, what your store must do outside the plugin, and which settings to check with a lawyer.

parts.check: What to check with a lawyer

gpsr.summary: Product safety data required by the General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR).
does: Stores the manufacturer, the responsible person in the EU (for manufacturers outside the EU), product identification and safety warnings per language.
Profiles let you write a manufacturer once and attach it to many products; any field can be overridden on a product.
Lists products with missing data, checked daily and right after a product changes. Publishing is never blocked.
Returns the data, ready to display, at GET /store/compliance/gpsr/products/:id.
store: Show the data on the product page of the storefront (the plugin has no storefront components).
Collect the data from manufacturers and keep it up to date.
Write the warnings and safety information; the plugin only stores them.
check: Which fields your products need (Settings → GPSR: required fields).
Which languages warnings must be written in.

gdpr.summary: A consent register and data subject requests.
does: Keeps every consent given or withdrawn as an entry that cannot be changed; a changed text becomes a new version.
Stores cookie choices by an anonymous browser id and links them to the customer after sign-in.
Takes requests (access, portability, erasure, objection to marketing, rectification), confirms them by e-mail, tracks the deadline and warns before it.
Builds a data package (JSON and CSV) and anonymises a customer after an accepted erasure, keeping orders for accounting within the scope you set.
Emits compliance.consent_granted, compliance.consent_withdrawn, compliance.request_verification and compliance.customer_anonymized for other plugins.
store: Get the consent texts, the privacy policy and the request notice from a lawyer and paste them in.
Build the cookie banner and the request form in the storefront using the Store API.
Send the confirmation e-mail: another plugin (e.g. emails) listens to compliance.request_verification.
Answer requests within the deadline and send the data package to the person.
check: The deadline for answers (30 days by default) and when it may be extended.
The anonymisation scope and how long billing data must be kept for invoices (72 months by default).
Whether the request records themselves (with the e-mail address) may be kept as proof of handling.

omnibus.summary: Price history and the lowest price before a discount.
does: Records every change of a variant's price per region and currency, with tax, as the customer sees it; takes a snapshot of all prices first.
Treats a sale price list and (optionally) automatic promotions without cart conditions as discounts; codes are skipped unless you count them.
Computes the lowest price of the period before each discount; uses the time since sales started for newer products; flags incomplete history after installation.
Returns current, regular and lowest price at GET /store/compliance/omnibus/variants/:id?region_id=.
store: Show the lowest prior price next to every discount in the storefront.
Check discounts flagged as incomplete history by hand: prices from before the installation are unknown to the plugin.
check: Whether promotions and codes count as price reductions for your store.
Exceptions such as perishable goods or gradual discounts (off by default).

demo.title: Demo mode
demo.body: Switch it on in Settings to show the panel with sample data (products missing GPSR data, requests in different states, prices with discounts). Nothing real is changed while it is on, and the storefront keeps working on real data.
